messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a **complete reference** of the *federal* and most common *provincial/territorial* statutory holidays that created long‑weekends in Canada during 2023.  
(If your application needs only the nationwide “bank” holidays, see the first section.)

| Holiday | Date 2023 | Weekend Adjacent? | Notes |
|---------|-----------|-------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 01 (Sunday) | Yes – Sunday itself → 2‑day weekend (Sat 31–Sun 1) | Federal & almost all provinces |
| **Family Day** *(BC, AB, SK, NB)* | Feb 20 (Monday) | Yes – Monday + Sat/Sun before | Not observed in ON, QC, PEI, NL, NS, MB, YT, NT, NU |
| **Good Friday** | Mar 10 (Friday) | Yes – Fri+Sat | Observed federally & provincially except Quebec |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Mon) | Yes – Mon+Sat | Federal & many provinces (except BC, NB, PEI, NL, NS, YT, NT, NU) |
| **St. Patrick’s Day** *(NB, PEI)* | Mar 16 (Thu) | No | Only those provinces observe it as a statutory holiday |
| **Saint George’s Day** *(PEI)* | Apr 23 (Fri) | Yes – Fri+Sat | Provincial only |
| **National Indigenous Peoples Day** *(AB, BC, Manitoba, Saskatchewan)* | Jun 21 (Tue) | No | Some provinces treat it as a holiday |
| **Civic Holiday** *(most provinces)* | Aug 07 (Mon) | Yes – Mon+Sat | Excludes Ontario, Québec, Nunavut, Northwest Territories |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 04 (Mon) | Yes – Mon+Sat | Federal & all provinces |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 09 (Mon) | Yes – Mon+Sat | Federal & all provinces |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Wed) | No | Observed federally; some provinces make it a paid day off |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Mon) | Yes – Mon+Sat | Federal & all provinces |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tue) | No | Federal & all provinces |

### How to use this data in your app

```json
{
  "holidays": [
    {"name":"New Year’s Day","date":"2023-01-01"},
    {"name":"Family Day","date":"2023-02-20", "province":["BC","AB","SK","NB"]},
    ...
  ]
}
```

Add a `isLongWeekend` flag (`true` if the holiday falls on Saturday, Sunday, or creates a 3‑day stretch with a weekday adjacent):

```js
holiday.isLongWeekend =
  holiday.date.getDay() === 0 ||   // Sunday
  holiday.date.getDay() === 6 ||   // Saturday
  /* or */
  (holiday.weekendAdjacency && !holiday.removed);
```

---

#### Quick Reference Table (Federal Holidays)

| Holiday | Date 2023 | Long‑Weekend? |
|---------|-----------|---------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 01 | ✅ |
| Good Friday | Mar 10 | ✅ |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | ✅ |
| Civic Holiday | Aug 07 | ❌ (only certain provinces) |
| Labour Day | Sep 04 | ✅ |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 09 | ✅ |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | ✅ |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | ❌ |

> **Tip:** If you’re targeting users across multiple provinces, keep a mapping of each province’s unique holidays so you can filter accordingly.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full provincial breakdowns or API endpoints that return this data!
